body: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent pixel-art character proposals for a top-down/three-quarter 2D game mod, not a traced or ripped game sprite. Draw Norse-era KRATOS from God of War: bald ash-pale skin, dark full beard, recognisable red tattoo over his left scalp/eye and exposed shoulder, practical dark brown leather diagonal harness and asymmetric shoulder armour, dark red Spartan waist cloth, brown trousers and boots, wrapped bracers. Restrained silver/gold fittings. References inspected: official God of War Ragnarok Kratos cosplay guide pages 3 and 5; use the light combat outfit without the heavy fur cloak. Original simple blocky pixel drawings like small readable strategy-game fighters: about 40 logical visible body pixels high, clear connected whole-body anatomy, thick tidy outlines, two-tone shading, consistent body height and lighting in every pose. Flat readable clothing, no speckled texture or realistic rendering. Transparent background. Eight separate complete full-body proposals in an exact four-column two-row evenly spaced grid, each occupying only its own cell with generous empty padding. In reading order: 1 front/three-quarter standing with Leviathan Axe; 2 right-facing idle holding Leviathan Axe; 3 right-facing idle with paired curved Blades of Chaos on compact chains; 4 right-facing walking with axe; 5 forward frost axe cleave; 6 broad fiery Blades sweep; 7 Guardian Shield raised in front with axe held back; 8 planted frost-and-fire ground-smash preparation holding both weapons. Axe has a dark wooden haft and a distinctive broad curved silver blade, restrained icy cyan edge; hands grip the HAFT, never the cutting head. Blades are compact bronze/dark hooked swords with orange edges on dark chains. Shield compact round bronze/iron folding guardian design. Weapon effects minimal: we need to see the whole body and hands. All figures remain the same person and scale, including action poses. Feet fully visible; no torso/leg separation. No background, shadows, labels, lettering, watermarks, interface, grid lines, other characters, Mimir head or scenery. Render as deliberately coarse low-resolution pixel art enlarged with nearest-neighbour edges, not a painterly illustration.
fenrir: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent pixel-art Fenrir appearance proposal for God of War crossover game mod. Reference inspected: God of War Ragnarok giant Fenrir screenshot reproduced at https://p5.itc.cn/q_70/images03/20221219/4a16658b4be54e65a98c3e66cf647209.png . Draw a powerful long-bodied wolf with thick charcoal/grey-brown fur, silver-grey cheeks and muzzle, a pale patch around one eye, hazel-amber eyes, large paws, broad chest and a bushy tail. Recognisable animal anatomy, four legs, connected body. Original artwork, no traced pixels. Simple blocky low-resolution pixel style with clean dark outline, restrained two-tone fur shading, no individual hair rendering, no armour or fantasy horns. Native intended profile about 48 logical pixels nose-to-tail and 25 pixels high; draw enlarged for inspection, so it will remain clear when reduced to game size. Four equally spaced full-animal proposals in an exact two-column two-row grid on a transparent background: 1 right-facing standing/ready to run profile, 2 left-facing matching profile, 3 three-quarter front ready pose, 4 right-facing running stride concept. All the same wolf, palette, body scale and lighting. Keep space around every animal, nothing clipped, no props, character riders, background, ground shadows, labels, lettering, watermarks or grid lines. No green eyes; realm energy will be a separate effect. Deliberately coarse pixel art, not painterly or photorealistic.
